# Executive summary {.unnumbered}

This report presents the Statistical Analysis Plan (StAP) for the SoilHarmony project. The core of the project centres around so-called transfer functions (TF) and pedotransfer functions (PTF) as referred to in the EU Soil Monitoring Law (SML): @SML_directive2025_2360.
